data.name: Nuno
data.gender_notes: Nuno is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'natus', meaning 'born'. In Portuguese, 'Nuno' means 'noble' or 'gift of God'. The name Nuno carries the meaning “Noble, Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Nuno usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nuno belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuno total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: נונו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם נונו עשוי להיות קשור למילה העברית 'נון' שפירושה 'דג' או 'מנוחה'. ייתכן כי השם מתאר אדם שמביא מנוחה או נחמה לאחרים, בהתאם למסורת הנוצרית והיהודית.

in_greek.name: Νούνο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νούνο πιθανόν να συνδέεται με τη λατινική λέξη 'nonnus', που σημαίνει 'κηπουρός' ή 'υπηρέτης'. Στην παράδοση των Ανατολικών Ορθοδόξων Εκκλησιών, το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει την πνευματική ανάπτυξη και την ανανέωση.

in_latin.name: Nuno
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Nuno derivare potest ex latino vocabulo 'nonnus', quod significat 'servus' vel 'minister'. In traditione christiana, nomen hoc saeculo utebatur pro persona humilis et devota.

in_english.name: Nuno
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nuno has roots in Latin and possibly Hebrew, conveying the meanings of 'new', 'renewed', or 'dedicated servant'. It may symbolize spiritual rebirth and devotion. Historically, the name has been used in Christian traditions, signifying humility and commitment to faith.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nuno holds a rich cultural heritage in the Portuguese-speaking world. Historically, the name was associated with the Portuguese nobility and upper class. This is evident in many Portuguese tales and mythologies, which feature a character named Nuno as a strong, courageous, and noble figure. Going beyond the historic context, Nuno is still a popular name in Portugal and Brazil, and it remains a source of pride among the Portuguese and Brazilian communities due to its noble roots.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond its cultural importance, the name Nuno carries a deep spiritual significance. In the Christian tradition, Nuno is often seen as a representation of the gift of God. The name reminds us of the incredible blessings we receive from God at our birth and throughout our lives. In addition, Nuno is also a reminder of the noble calling we have as Christians to live a life of integrity, courage, and love in imitation of Christ. By bearing the name Nuno, one is encouraged to strive to be a 'gift of God' to the world and to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Nuno, meaning "given by God" in Portuguese, symbolizes the belief in divine providence and trust in God's plan for one's life. It is a reminder of our dependence on God and the grace He bestows upon us.

historical_references.reference: Nuno Alvares Pereira, a Portuguese knight who led the Christian forces to victory over the Moors at the Battle of Aljubarrota in 1385.
historical_references.context: During the Reconquista, the Christian kingdoms in Europe were gradually retaking land from the Moors in what is now Portugal. Nuno Alvares Pereira's victory at Aljubarrota marked a turning point in the conflict.

historical_references.reference: Nuno Lopez de Guzman, a Spanish nobleman who led the Christian forces against the Moors in the Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212.
historical_references.context: During the Reconquista, Christian forces under the command of Nuno Lopez de Guzman defeated the combined armies of the Almohad caliphate and the Christian kingdoms of León and Navarre. This victory is considered to be a major turning point in the Reconquista.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Nuno continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Nuno from New York, United States embodies the meaning of Nuno - "Noble, Gift of God". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
